Abd Allah ibn Umar (kunya "Kunya (Arabic)") Abu Abd al-Rahman : 156) was born in 610 in Mecca,: 207 three years after the beginning of Muhammad's message.: 156 He was the son of Umar ibn al-Khattab and Zaynab bint Maz'un.: 203–204 His full siblings were Hafsa and Abd al-Rahman.

native_retrieval.title: 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar: A Biography — Imam Ghazali Institute
native_retrieval.snippet: 'Abdullah ibn 'Umar رضي الله عنه: A Biography. *This article is excerpted from* *Morning and Evening Invocations**, a collection of du’a and adhkar from the Qur’an, Sunnah, and righteous scholars published by IGI in 2021. He رضي الله عنه presented himself to the Prophet ﷺ on the day of Uhud, but the Prophet ﷺ deemed him too young and sent him back. He رضي الله عنه presented himself to the Prophet ﷺ on the day of Badr. Three of the reports included in The Forty Hadith of Imam al-Nawawi are narrated from Ibn ‘Umar رضي الله عنه. He رضي الله عنه is from amongst the young companions who benefited tremendously from the companionship of the Prophet ﷺ. A famous narration from the *Shama’il* of Imam al-Tirmidhi describes how he رضي الله عنه observed the Prophet ﷺ very closely while he was still a boy, such that he رضي الله عنه even counted the number of white hairs on the Prophet’s head ﷺ:.

native_retrieval.title: Abdullah ibn Umar - Sahaba Story | Companion of the Prophet
native_retrieval.snippet: He had accepted Islam before he was ten years old and had made the Hijrah with his father and his sister, Hafsah, who was later to become a wife of the Prophet. Before Uhud he was also turned away from the Battle of Badr and it was not until the Battle of the Ditch the he and Usamah, both now fifteen years old and others of their age were allowed to join the ranks of the men not only for the digging of the trench but for the battle when it came. Similarly he was extremely cautious and reluctant to make legal judgments (fatwas).' Once someone came to him asking for a judgment on a particular matter and Abdullah ibn Umar replied: "I have no knowledge of what you ask." The man went on his way and Abdullah clapped his hands in glee and said to himself: "The son of Umar was asked about what he does not know and he said: I do not know.".
